explanation: Keep counts for the previous two prefixes. A nonzero final digit contributes the preceding count; a final pair from 10 through 26 contributes the count two positions earlier. Arbitrary-precision counters preserve intermediate counts before returning the contract’s int-sized final count.
timeComplexity: O(n) arithmetic operations for n digits; big-integer costs depend on intermediate count width.
spaceComplexity: Two arbitrary-precision integer counts, using O(n) bits in the worst case.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 JavaScript algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
